items.passageEn: The kids sit in a circle on the warm grass. The teacher says, "Be quiet, please. Listen to the following rules. Work in pairs. Play fair!" The kids have a wonderful time.
items.passageZh: 孩子們在溫暖的草地上圍坐成一圈。老師說：「請安靜，聽好下面的規則：兩人一組。要公平地玩！」孩子們玩得很開心。

rubricZh: 「公平的」用 fair（例如 This game is fair；寫 This is a fair game 也正確）

items.promptZh: 這件外套穿起來很暖和。
referenceEn: I feel warm in this coat.
rubricZh: 可寫，例如 This coat keeps me warm、I feel warm in this coat、This coat is warm 等
